raw_segments.text: Lear, I every inch a king. When I do stare, see how the subject quakes. I pardon that
man's life. What was thy cause? Adultery. Thou shalt not die, die for adultery. No,
the wren goes taut, and the small gilded fly does letcher in my sight. Let copulation thrive,
for Gloucester's bastard son was kinder to his father than my daughter's got tween
the lawful sheets. Taut, luxury, pell-mel, for I lack soldiers.
Behold, yond, simpering dame, whose face between her forks presages snow. That mince's virtue,
and does shake the head to hear of Pleasure's name. The fitchew nor the soiled horse goes taut
with a more riotous appetite. Down from the waist they are centaurs, though women all above. But to
the girdle do the gods inherit, beneath is all the fiends. There's hell, there's darkness, there
is the sulphurous pit, burning, scalding, stench consumption. Fie, fie, fie. Pa, pa.
Give me an ounce of civet, good apothecary, to sweeten my imagination. There's money for thee.
